impact: ask() in src/onboard.ts:22 returns a promise that never resolves if readline emits 'close' before the answer arrives. On Ctrl-D (EOF) mid-question the event loop drains and the process exits 0 with no message and no PERSONA.md — a success-looking exit for an abandoned run. Pre-existing since T-009, but it only became user-facing in 1.3.1 when `zug onboard` became a real dispatched command (ISS-052). Fix needs runOnboard() to reject/return on readline close and print "[zug] Onboarding cancelled — no changes made." Testing it properly wants input/output stream injection into runOnboard() so a PassThrough can simulate EOF, rather than a child-process pty harness. Found by the independent review of the ISS-052 diff.
title: zug onboard exits 0 with no PERSONA.md when the user backs out with Ctrl-D
